## Description

This workspace includes JupyterGIS in JupyterLab. JupyterGIS is an in-browser geographic information system (GIS) for working with geospatial data and map projects. It can be used for exploring and visualizing spatial data alongside notebook-based research workflows.

Features include:

- Working with different data formats such as GeoJSON, GeoTIFF/COG, GeoParquet, GeoPackage, and Shapefile, as well as web map services (WMS/WMTS).
- Collaborating on maps in real time.
- Importing and exporting QGIS projects.

See the [JupyterGIS documentation](https://jupytergis.readthedocs.io/) for the full feature list and usage instructions.

### Based on VRE Lab

This workspace is based on [VRE Lab](vre-lab.qmd), with JupyterGIS preinstalled. It provides the same general JupyterLab environment and workspace options as VRE Lab. Refer to VRE Lab documentation for details about creating and using the workspace.
